summary: Listed as Savary at Canada Lookouts in Bulkley-Nechako; only a 1940 newspaper mention, spelled Savory, found.

events.note: Summer 1940 at the look-out at Savory, per a September 25, 1940 Interior News item quoted by Canada Lookouts.

evidence.supports: summer 1940 at the forestry look-out at Savory
evidence.quote: Mr. F. Stearns has returned home after spending the summer in the forestry look-out at Savory.

notes_for_editor: No story written: one 1940 newspaper item, secondhand via Canada Lookouts, plus coordinates. That cannot reach the 120-word floor without padding. Name conflict: the record and listing say Savary; the 1940 quote says Savory. A search snippet (not fetched) lists a community called Savory about 21 km from Fraser Lake; unconfirmed as the lookout site. Two WebSearch calls used. The BC Archives fire-lookout listing could not be read (certificate errors).
